description: THE FIRST ARM SINCE F4 THAT IS ALLOWED TO PASS ITS GATE, and it exists to measure the INSTRUMENT rather than to tune the model. Every arm since F4 died at iteration 100 because the runner's gate watcher kills the JVM when any mode is past the stop bar and seven are; nothing in this project has ever been read deeper than iteration 104. That is why the reading point cannot score a candidate (9.158, 9.159, #163): between iterations 80 and 100 of the SAME run, with nothing changed, heavy rail, bike and taxi each move further from or towards target than the WHOLE CAL.gate.pass_deviation_pct band, and the movement is UPWARD on every one of the six arms measured. 9.159 established WHY averaging cannot repair that - the movement is a monotone TREND, not scatter. On the F23 arm every scored mode's series over it.40 to it.100 is monotone without a single reversal (car 59.78 -> 66.94, walk 14.55 -> 9.76, bike 6.23 -> 4.66, heavy rail 27,948 -> 19,140), and a mean over a monotone series is just its centre, so a 40-iteration window ending at 100 reads iteration ~80 and the gap between two windowed readings is the gap between their centres. Measured: the windowed drift on heavy rail is 31.65 points against the point reading's 10.91 - WORSE, exactly as a trend predicts. So the only thing that can answer where a reading settles is depth, and depth is what this arm buys. THE GATE WATCHER IS DISABLED (RUN.gate.interval_iterations = 0) AND THAT IS A DELIBERATE, SCOPED DEPARTURE FROM THE GOAL.md LOOP, recorded at 9.159. The loop's rule - stop at the gate, find the cause, fix it from the root - presumes the gate reading MEANS something, and this session measured that at iteration 100 it does not. An arm whose whole purpose is to find where the reading settles cannot be stopped at the point whose validity is under test. The departure is scoped to THIS overlay: the loop stays in force everywhere else, NO parameter is chosen on anything this arm reads, and the arm's readings enter the record as a description of the INSTRUMENT (where does each mode's series flatten, and by which iteration) and never as a calibration result. It also measures requirement 8 for the first time - convergence in at most 250 iterations - because innovation switches off at 240 and the post-cutoff window straddles 250; and if it reaches its horizon its record says ran_to_last_iteration, which no run has said since F4. IT OPENS A COMPARABILITY FAMILY and is its first arm: it carries the #167 repair, so its pt access and egress legs are ROUTED ON THE WALK NETWORK rather than drawn and teleported (RUN.transit_router.access_egress_basis = network), which changes what the router returns for every pt trip. NOTHING BEFORE IT COMPARES WITH ANYTHING AFTER IT (3.5), and it must not be compared with F31 or any earlier family however tempting the story. COST: MEASURED, NOT PROJECTED. arm_cost.py prices it at 22.2 h from the F31 arm's own stopwatch - 297 recurring iterations at 260.0 s, the one-off iterations at their own cost, plus 20 min of setup - against a recent spread of 22.0 to 31.7 h across the last five arms at this fraction. The approved CEILING IS 32 h (user, 8 September 2026, on the quoted range); stop the arm at the cost that was approved rather than at the one it turns out to have. 25% is the standing directive (user, 1 September 2026). Answers #163, and reads what #167, #98, #107, #86, #48, #94, #30, #82, #96, #108, #145, #93, #66 and #131 are waiting on.

justification.RUN.gate.interval_iterations: 0 disables the gate watcher, which is the only way an arm can pass iteration 100 while seven modes sit past the stop bar - and passing it is this arm's entire purpose. The GOAL.md loop's hard bar presumes its reading resolves the goal band; 9.158 and 9.159 measured that at iteration 100 it does not, because the model is still moving monotonically in every mode. Suspending the bar for an arm that measures WHERE it stops moving is not a workaround for the bar, it is the measurement the bar's own validity depends on. Scoped to this overlay, recorded at DECISIONS.md 9.159, and binding nothing: no parameter is tuned on anything this arm reads.
